title: docs(types): date the rotted `tsconfig.test.json` invariant and name the carve-out it stopped covering
body:
Fixes #9737

Clause-②: no

`packages/types/tsconfig.test.json` closed with an invariant in the imperative — *"Every test file in this package is compiled; keep it that way."* — which is false today, and false in the file that states it. This amends that one comment, and nothing else.

## The verdict was measured, not inherited — ROTTED, not born false

Orphans = files under `packages/types/src/__tests__/` matching **neither** `src/**/*.test.ts` nor `src/**/*.test.tsx`. Re-derived per ref with `git ls-tree` in this branch's worktree, never from a working tree. Every zero carries a **lit control on the same instrument and the same corpus** — the files that DO match — so a zero is a reading, not a dead probe.

| ref | date | what it is | orphans | **[LIT CTRL]** files in the program |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `c35fed098` | 2026-08-07 | the sentence's write-time ref (PR #3574) | **0** | 28 |
| `dd5b01b59` | 2026-09-02 | `DIST_PIN_GLOB` / the `dist` project lands (PR #7291) | **0** | 85 |
| `8195905bf` | 2026-09-09 | the commit immediately before the falsifier | **0** | 152 |
| `1ccfc235e` | 2026-09-09 | **the falsifier** — PR #8646 adds the file | **1** | 153 |
| `1cfdff814` | today | `origin/main` at branch point | **1** | 204 |

The orphan is `packages/types/src/__tests__/zod-subpath-single-module-8598.dist.spec.tsx`.

Two independent legs establish ROTTED rather than BORN FALSE:

1. The `include` line at the write-time ref is **byte-for-byte** the one in force today (`diff` of the two lines exits 0) ⇒ the sentence did not drift by its own config moving; the population moved under it.
2. Tree-wide at `c35fed098`, the count of `.dist.spec.tsx` files is **0** (lit control: 3716 tracked files at that ref) ⇒ the construction that falsifies the sentence **did not yet exist anywhere in the repo** when it was written. This leg holds whichever commit is taken to be the write-time ref, so the verdict does not rest on `git log -S` in a shallow checkout.

`git log -S'Every test file in this package is compiled'` over that path returns `c35fed098` and nothing else in the fetched window.

⇒ TRUE when written, true for thirty-three days, falsified on 2026-09-09 by a single identified commit. So the sentence is **kept and dated**, not overwritten — overwriting it would erase that it was ever true (#9713).

## What the repair says now

The exclusion the sentence stopped covering is **a construction with a stated reason and a cited card**, not a hole — and a declared exclusion and a hole look identical in a directory listing. The amended invariant therefore states all three things a reader would otherwise have to re-derive:

- **the carve-out** — the `.dist.spec.tsx` built-artifact pins are outside this program;
- **its reason** — turbo's `type-check` waits on `^build` (the DEPENDENCIES' builds) and must never be handed a program that reads this package's own `dist`; #4801 removed a self-referencing `paths` entry for exactly that reason;
- **its runner** — the pins are still RUN, by the opt-in `dist` vitest project (`DIST_PIN_GLOB`, env-gated, reached through `pnpm test:dist`), built on purpose by #7183.

Two repo rules shaped the wording:

- **AGENTS.md #9** — no count is written into the prose. The comment points at `pnpm type-check:coverage` (`scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs`), which re-derives the claim and happens to share the same `*.test.ts(x)` definition, so the two agree by construction rather than by coincidence.
- **AGENTS.md #11** — `vitest.config.mts` is cited by the `DIST_PIN_GLOB` **symbol**, never by a cross-file line address. `pnpm check:new-line-citations` prints `0 new citation(s)` for this branch.

## ⛔ What did NOT change — measured, not asserted

No `include`, no `exclude`, no compiler option, no test file moved. Proven at the level of program inputs rather than of the diff:

`tsc -p CONFIG --noEmit --listFiles`, run for all three legs of this package's `type-check` script, **before and after** the edit:

| program | exit | `--listFiles` diff, before vs after |
|---|---|---|
| `tsconfig.json` | 0 | `diff` exit **0** — byte-identical |
| `tsconfig.examples.json` | 0 | `diff` exit **0** — byte-identical |
| `tsconfig.test.json` | 0 | `diff` exit **0** — byte-identical |

On that same `--listFiles` output for `tsconfig.test.json`: the orphan pin appears **0** times, and the lit control `src/__tests__/base-bind-declared.test.ts` appears **1** time — the carve-out read directly off the real program, not off the globs.

## Gates

Exit codes captured to disk before any pipe.

| gate | exit | verdict line |
|---|---|---|
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` (all three legs) | **0** | `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.examples.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` |
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/` (repo root) | **0** | `Test Files 204 passed (204)` · `Tests 4771 passed (4771)` |
| `pnpm type-check:coverage` | **0** | `test type-check coverage: 43/43 packages compile their tests, 0 declared debt` |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | **0** | `No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range` |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | **0** | `0 new citation(s), enforcement report-only` |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | **0** | `OK (scanned 7840 tracked text file(s))` |
| `pnpm check:published-tsconfig-exclude` | **0** | |
| `pnpm check:self-import` | **0** | |
| `pnpm check:changeset-claims` | **0** | |
| `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals` | **0** | |
| `pnpm check:comment-mask-corpus` | **0** | |
| `pnpm census:tsconfig-test-parity` | **0** | |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` (both changed paths) | **0** | `NOT GOVERNED — 2 path(s) checked against 5 governed surface(s)`; **[LIT CTRL]** `AGENTS.md` ⇒ exit 3, `GOVERNED` |

All figures above were taken at `837cea2f9`, this branch's final commit.

**Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's run; the local narrowing is declared and proven.** eslint's own flat config declares its universe as `**/*.{ts,tsx}` (plus `**/*.tsx`) and nothing else; run over the two changed paths with `--no-inline-config --format json` it reports **2** files, **0** errors, and for each one its own message *"File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied."* No `.ts`/`.tsx` file changed at all, and no tsconfig program input moved (table above), so no untouched file's verdict can move either.

## The changeset grade is MEASURED

`packages/types`' `files[]` is `["dist", "README.md", "CHANGELOG.md", "LICENSE"]`, so anything reaching `dist` publishes. After `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build`, scanning all **130** emitted `dist` files:

| probe | hits |
|---|---|
| `DATED READING` (bytes this PR adds) | **0** |
| `Every test file in this package is compiled` (bytes this PR keeps and quotes) | **0** |
| `DIST_PIN_GLOB` (bytes this PR adds) | **0** |
| **[LIT CTRL]** source-comment prose known to ship (`registry key`) | **5** — `field-types.d.ts`, `zod/node-derivation.d.ts`, … |
| **[ABSENT CTRL]** a nonsense token | **0** |

The lit control proves the instrument is connected on the same corpus, and the absent control proves it is not matching everything. ⇒ nothing published moved, and the changeset declares that with **empty frontmatter** — which is the claim, made explicitly rather than by analogy to a `base.ts` comment (whose prose *does* ship into `dist/base.d.ts`, and would have been graded `patch`).

## A count is invariant under quotation — probed separately, both reported

The repair quotes the old sentence, so quoted position and assertion position were probed apart with a whitespace-tolerant whole-content scan (`git grep` is line-anchored and this is wrapped JSON-with-comments):

| position | occurrences |
|---|---|
| total, any position | **1** (`packages/types/tsconfig.test.json`) |
| quoted position (opens with a double quote) | **1** |
| **assertion position** (total − quoted) | **0** |
| **[LIT CTRL]** `DATED READING`, known present and unquoted | **1** |
| **[ABSENT CTRL]** a nonsense token | **0** |

The changeset body carries one further occurrence, also in quoted position. ⇒ no live, undated assertion of the sentence survives anywhere in the tree.

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured in passing, and it dissolves rather than opens the second card.** The dispatch fenced out "every package with a `.dist.spec.tsx` pin and a `tsconfig.test.json` may carry the same sentence-vs-population question". Tree-wide there are exactly **2** `.dist.spec.tsx` files (lit control: 7925 tracked files), in `packages/types` and `packages/components`, and both packages do have a `tsconfig.test.json`. But the whole-content scan for the invariant sentence returns **1** hit, in `packages/types` only: `packages/components/tsconfig.test.json` states no such invariant. ⇒ there is no second site to repair. Noted, not filed; handed back to the dispatching seat.
- The triage seat's optional escalation probe (has anyone already widened an `include` on the strength of this sentence ⇒ p1) reads **negative** in the fetched window: the only two commits touching `packages/types/tsconfig.test.json` are `c35fed098` and `4e96becf5`, and the latter moved `lib` only. ⚠️ The checkout is shallow, so this is a NOT-FULLY-MEASURED negative rather than a proven absence.
